entry.author: Queenstown Lakes District Council
entry.summary:
What is the Head Start pathway? Does Queenstown Lakes have to amalgamate?

There's a lot of change happening in government at the moment, and one topical change is the future of local government. QLDC Interim Chief Executive Michelle Morss and Mayor John Glover recently sat down to talk about what is going on and what progress has been made.

Grab a cuppa and get informed!
